what: Every range Decidível's demonstrator declares, each with where it comes from. A range is a box the engine decides over in full; narrowing one is a measurement, and the page prices which.

sources.s: The dry frame, Kdry = s·(1 − φ/φc)·Kmin (Nur's critical-porosity trend, φc = 0.40): the box of s is the hull of the nine pre-salt plugs of Quadros et al. 2025 (Sci. Rep. 15:33467, doi 10.1038/s41598-025-11646-y, Iracema, Santos Basin; lab Vp, Vs and dry bulk density), each read as Kdry = ρ(Vp² − 4/3·Vs²) against its Hill mineral modulus from the paper's XRD and mineral table.
sources.gk: Gdry/Kdry on the same nine plugs: 0.278 to 0.672.
sources.Kmin: From 61 GPa (the plugs' Hill average of calcite 63.7, dolomite 69.4 and quartz 37 GPa, Quadros et al. 2025) to 71 GPa (calcite as usually tabulated, Mavko et al.).
sources.Kw: Brine by Batzle & Wang 1992 (Geophysics 57:1396) at 60 MPa and 90 °C, salinity 0.10 to 0.225: 3.21 to 3.75 GPa; densities 1.07 to 1.17 g/cm³ (computed at 65 °C, widened).
sources.Ko: Live oil by Batzle & Wang 1992, API 28–30 and GOR 200–300 m³/m³ (the Tupi oil, Cruz et al. 2021): 0.77 to 1.02 GPa, 0.67 to 0.73 g/cm³.
sources.Kg: The injected gas, from methane (0.219 GPa, 0.263 g/cm³ at 60 MPa and 65 °C) to pure CO2 (0.430 GPa and 0.890 g/cm³ at 60 MPa and 90 °C; 0.604 GPa and 0.970 g/cm³ at 65 MPa and 65 °C), NIST Webbook (Span–Wagner). Tupi reinjects high-CO2 (≈80%) and low-CO2 (≈5%) gas (Cruz et al. 2021); UNISIM-IV's gas is 44% CO2.
sources.Swi: UNISIM-IV-2026 relative-permeability tables for stromatolites and coquinas: Swi = 0.18, Sorg = 0.35, so the largest mobile gas saturation is 0.47.
sources.w: How the injected gas sits in the pores, from uniform (Reuss, w = 0) to patchy (Voigt, w = 1): every Brie exponent lies between. Nobody measures it before the survey.
sources.theta: Detection thresholds on |ΔIp/Ip|: 2% was the pre-salt feasibility threshold and ≈1.5% the limit reached with ocean-bottom nodes at the Tupi pilot, with NRMS ≈2–3% (Cruz et al. 2021, SBGf 17th International Congress; The Leading Edge 40(12):886).

headline.why: A coquina cell at the benchmark's median porosity (0.139), a WAG gas front between 15% and 30% saturation, and the Tupi pilot's 1.5% detection limit.
